spans.text: A jifa ndɔlei nasia ti dunyi hu ti lahei wumbua a ngoyila kɔɔ ti tɔ kɛ baagɔ ma a yɛlɔ na nuvuu va kɛɛ ngi lɔnya ya va,

Numu gbi lee ndɔlɔlii a ngie, ngi lɔlei kpɔma hugbatɛ wie ngi va, tao kɔɔ ngi lɔlei taa ngitiwoma hugbatɛ ti pee ye kpɔma hugbatei na i foo ngi ma, tao a majɔɔlɔ kialeke ngi lɔlei gbatɛi kɛɛ ye saweisia ti na, gbɔma kia lekee ye numui bɛɛ ngi hami gii na, kɔɔ wei i lɛgulɔ.
Nuu gbi ngi lɔnya mia nahi ti la nyɔngaa ngi ma hinda ngamu va, taa kiti lewe haani ti ye njie na le fofohu, tao ti jia a sawe panda pandaa.

folded.id: hinda gbulaninga|na|ndɔlɔ woyila hugbatɛi i loila
folded.subject: hinda gbulaninga

spans.text: Ye sawei ji ɛɛ lɛkpɛ gbi naleke ye numui ji i ndɔlɔ jawa nyanini, tao i hinda gbulaninga na ndɔlɔ woyila hugbatɛi i loila.
Nuu gbi lɔnya mia kɔɔ ngi lɔɔhu guamɛti hugbatɛ wie ngoisia ti hiti ngi ma kia lee ta hiti nungaa ye pekeisia ma.

spans.text: Dunya Lahei ji nuvuu lɔnyinsia va i wote a ŋaiki numui kpɛlɛɛ kɛɛ ndɔlei kpɛlɛɛ va nahii kɛ numu gbi ɔɔ ngoyila hugbatɛ gbi na hinda yayilingɔi ji ngi ɛnmahu kpɔtu i lapi kpugu kpugu a numu gaalahu wie i tɔ kɛ bagɔɔma iyɛ tɔnɛi jisia ma kɛɛ hugbɛmboi jisia nungei nasia wɛti yei ndɔɔ kpɛlɛ hugbatai ji hu, kɛɛ nasia ti ndɔlɔngaa hu nahi tii yee ndɔlɔ kpɛlɛ hugbatɛi jisia bu.

folded.subject: i houni
folded.object: i kpagbaa la nuu ma na kaahu lewengɔ sawei na ma i nyanini

spans.text: Tao gbɔma maa i houni sawei i kpagbaa la nuu ma na kaahu lewengɔ sawei na ma i nyanini.
Numu gbi lɔnya mia kɔɔ i yenge, tao kɔɔ i ngengei na wie ngi longɔla, kɔɔ i mbɛlɛhei majɔɔ ngengemɛi, tao kɔɔ ti tɔ kɛngengei ɛɛ ngi lo.

folded.id: i yaa|ye|ndevui na wie ma ta yaalɔ a ngi pawa
folded.subject: i yaa
folded.object: ndevui na wie ma ta yaalɔ a ngi pawa

spans.text: Ngenge mɔgbi lɔnya mia kɔɔ i lɛvu tao kɔɔ i kpele yeka gbua, tao gbɔma kɔɔ aa ngenge huguangɔ waa wie, mahoungɔ gbɔma i yaa a ndɛvu wati majɔɔ, nahi i yaa ye ndevui na wie ma ta yaalɔ a ngi pawa.

folded.id: i yɛ|na|nahi ta loko wili ngi bundu hinda hu
folded.subject: i yɛ
folded.object: nahi ta loko wili ngi bundu hinda hu

spans.text: Maa ii houni nuu i yɛ na nahi ta loko wili ngi bundu hinda hu, ngi ye pɛɛbu hinda, kɔlei kɛɛ ngowili na a pili ngitiwoma kia lee ti longɔla, kɛɛ kakpama a baagbuama hu we.

folded.id: i|na|lee hinda huwu va ii le
folded.subject: i
folded.object: lee hinda huwu va ii le

spans.text: Nuu gbi lɔnya mia kɔɔ taa nungaa ti gomɛ, tao kɔɔ taa teini ti lee, i na lee hinda huwu va ii le.

folded.id: jifa kiliyei|na|kɛ numu vuu kpɛlɛɛ ti maa hɛwulei lɔ towa kpaupau le laha va
folded.subject: jifa kiliyei
folded.object: kɛ numu vuu kpɛlɛɛ ti maa hɛwulei lɔ towa kpaupau le laha va

spans.text: A jifa kiliyei na kɛ numu vuu kpɛlɛɛ ti maa hɛwulei lɔ towa kpaupau le laha va, tɔnya kɛɛ ndilɛli dunyihu.
A jifa maa ii houni nu mu vuu i wote a kɔ gɔmɔ mahaya nyamu nyamu kɛɛ nduwɔ ya yeya, kɛ mahoingɔɛ sawei i nuvuu lɔnyii mavale,

folded.id: kɛɛ ngowili|na|a pili ngitiwoma kia lee ti longɔla
folded.subject: kɛɛ ngowili
folded.object: a pili ngitiwoma kia lee ti longɔla

spans.text: Maa ii houni nuu i yɛ na nahi ta loko wili ngi bundu hinda hu, ngi ye pɛɛbu hinda, kɔlei kɛɛ ngowili na a pili ngitiwoma kia lee ti longɔla, kɛɛ kakpama a baagbuama hu we.

folded.object: numui bɛɛ ngi hami gii na

folded.id: maa houngɔ|sawei|i nuu gbi maawɛɛ yɛɛ kakpamɛi ji bondayeya
folded.subject: Maa houngɔ
folded.object: i nuu gbi maawɛɛ yɛɛ kakpamɛi ji bondayeya

spans.text: Maa houngɔ sawei i nuu gbi maawɛɛ yɛɛ kakpamɛi ji bondayeya.
A jifa mahoingɔ ndiamɔyei na ndɔlesialuahu i lɛgulɔma,

folded.subject: mahoungɔ nduwɔyei

spans.text: Maa ii houni ti numu gbi hou nduwɔya hu, ɔɔ ti ngi waa mɔnɛmɔnɛ hinda hu, maa ii houni nuu maajia va nduwɔya hu, tao gbɔma mahoungɔ nduwɔyei ye kɛyi kgbi lekee i gbɔyɔ.

spans.text: Mahoungɔ sawei i tɔ kɛ hugbatei ji ɛɛ numugbi gbukpuu.

spans.text: Nuvuu gbi lee ngi lɔnya mia kɔɔ sawei i baagɔɔ ngi nuvuu ya ma mia leke gbi.

Nuu gbi lɔya mia kɔɔ i kiiya wee, kɔɔ i giila gbɔɔ tɔnyɛi le ɔɔ gbɔɔ i lɔnyani, Ngewɔɛ ye gbɔɔ ngi longɔ i feli, ye tonye ji a ngi jein jein lɔ kɔɔ i ngi giliyei ɔɔ ngi yewɔveilei wote, I wote bɛɛ atayakpe ɔɔ taa nungaa, fofohu ɔɔ sɔkuma, kɔɔ i nungaa gaa a ngi ngliyei kɛɛ ngi yewɔ hindei.
Hugbatei ji numu kpɛlɛɛ lɔ va, nu gɛnyɛi, ngi luwu yɛgii, nyaha ɔɔ hindgo, nu layia, Ngewɔi na a feli, ngi gilii yei, ngi le gi kɛɛ ngi gbatɛ ii ma.
Nuu gbi ngi lɔnya mia kɔɔ i gbua ndɔlɔ yila hu i li peka hu, i wee a ngi yee ɔɔ mbaa tinda, tao kɔɔ i yama ngi ndei na hu mia i gbuanina.
Maa ii houni nuu i yɛ na nahi ta loko wili ngi bundu hinda hu, ngi ye pɛɛbu hinda, kɔlei kɛɛ ngowili na a pili ngitiwoma kia lee ti longɔla, kɛɛ kakpama a baagbuama hu we.
Hindui taa nyahii na ti lakpangɔ ta sɔɔwelɔ ti ndengaa le, ti gɛnyɛ ii yɛni bɛɛ yila, tii yɛni bɛɛ a ndɔlɔ yila hunblaa, ɔɔ Ngewɔ veli gbambi yila ma.

folded.subject: pie hindangaa
folded.object: hii i wotɛa a nɛmahugili waa nuvuu ma

spans.text: A jifa ngawulɛɛhu kɛɛ baagbuala nuvugaa ti lɔnyisia ma ti wanga a pie hindangaa na hii i wotɛa a nɛmahugili waa nuvuu ma, dunya ninahu mia mahoingɔ muvuu i gu i yɛpɛ kia ngi longɔla, kɛɛ ngi lanayei kɛɛ ngi lima hinda.

spans.text: Nuvuu kpɛlɛɛ ti maahɛwungɔɛ sawei gulɔ, tao mahoungɔ sawei i ti mahu wɛɛ nahi gbi ɛɛ ti hu wɔyɔ.
Nungaa mia maahoungɔ ti ti guamɛti hei, ti gbayei mia a pie a yenge, hulɛmbinga ta yamalɔ ti kɔlei gula, tao ye kɔlei ji a kgula bunduhulɔ, nahii nungbi ɛɛ gbekpa numu gulɔ.
